about: The introitus of the formulary “12th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, come to my aid; O Lord, make haste to help me. Let my enemies who seek my life be confounded and put to shame. Let those who devise evil against me be turned back and made to blush. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. O God, come to my aid; O Lord, make haste to help me. Let my enemies who seek my life be confounded and put to shame.
